response.sql: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) as track_count, SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) as byte_rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) as avg_byte_rate FROM media_type_stats), filtered_media_types AS (SELECT mts.byte_rate, mts.track_count, mts.byte_rate - oa.avg_byte_rate as rate_excess FROM media_type_stats mts CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE mts.byte_rate > oa.avg_byte_rate) SELECT AVG(byte_rate) as avg_rate, AVG(track_count) as avg_track_count, AVG(rate_excess) as avg_rate_excess FROM filtered_media_types
